vibe.verdict: Smart idea to move the menu to San Diego with the rex rampage jokes, but the poster is only a logo on black and it skips the trailer cliff and raptors in the long grass.
missing: Raptors in the long grass (the field ambush)
The trailer pushed over the cliff and Eddie's SUV
Malcolm: 'Ooh, ahh, that's how it always starts'
The rex stomping into the video store in San Diego
Kelly's gymnastics kick on the raptor
Roland and Ajay's restaurant scene (Roland's 'trophy room')
ideas: Swap 'Fish tacos with lime crema' for 'Long grass salad' with a raptor-in-the-grass note.
Swap 'Iced tea with lemon' note for a Malcolm line about how it always starts.
Swap the front cover logo-on-black for a still of the rex in the San Diego street.
Rename 'Rex parents' mud pie' note to 'Pushed halfway over the cliff, same as the trailer'.
iconic: Ooh, ah, that's how it always starts (Malcolm note)
Rex in San Diego, video store and backyard pool (house line, margarita)
changed: Malcolm note is now his real line
Roland hunting wink swapped for raptors in the long grass
